title: Botiga Theme Review
description: A documented profile of Botiga as an ecommerce-focused theme with product, catalog, and store-presentation controls.
metaDescription: A transparently scoped Botiga WordPress theme profile from KreativWP.
price: Free version available; check upgrades on the official site
highlights: The official directory positions Botiga for WooCommerce stores
Its listing documents product and shop presentation features
The theme is presented as a customizable ecommerce starting point
bestFor: Stores that need a focused WooCommerce visual foundation rather than a broad multipurpose theme.
researchScope: This profile reviews Botiga’s WordPress.org listing and published ecommerce positioning.
caveats: Test product pages, cart and checkout behavior, mobile catalog layouts, and the exact extension stack with a representative store before launch.
